content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Cloudflare webhook-driven crypto payment fulfillment is a self-owned commerce stack. It combines free and paid tools into a unified system. You host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. The moment payment confirms on-chain, a webhook triggers instant product delivery. No buyer accounts. No KYC. No platform fees. You own the entire stack. No one can shut it down. No one can delay your payouts. This is infrastructure sovereignty—built for regions where conventional payment systems fail.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The system starts with your storefront, hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. When a buyer purchases a product, they pay via crypto through NOWPayments. The payment is verified on-chain, and a webhook is fired to your backend logic. This logic, running on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, checks the payment status. If confirmed, it updates your order database (Supabase or Google Sheets) and triggers file delivery. The file is pulled from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and sent to the buyer’s email or download page. Every step is automated. Every component is replaceable. You own the code. You own the data. The system is stateless—no server to maintain. No platform to depend on. It’s commerce infrastructure you control, not rent.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software in Pakistan, Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or Bangladesh, this is for you. If you’ve faced payout delays, account freezes, or currency collapse, this is for you. If you’ve been forced to use P2P exchanges to convert USDT on Tron or Solana, this is for you. This system eliminates middlemen. It gives you direct access to global buyers. It ensures instant payment confirmation and automatic product delivery. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. You own it. You control it. You deploy it.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no platform dependence.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack relies on five core components. First, hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your storefront. Second, backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and file delivery. Third, order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets to track purchases. Fourth, file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store and serve your products. Fifth, payment processing: NOWPayments for on-chain crypto verification. Each component is modular. You can swap them out as needed. The system is designed for low fees and high reliability. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. The webhook-driven architecture ensures instant fulfillment. Every piece works together—but you own every piece.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). It deploys in 48 hours with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Five products are loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC is configured, and end-to-end testing is done. Or choose the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for full documentation and source code. If you’re technical, deploy it yourself using the free tools outlined here. The key is to act. Stop waiting for Stripe or PayPal to approve your region. Stop relying on platforms that can shut you down. Build your own infrastructure. Own your commerce stack. Deploy today. Sell globally. Get paid directly. No middlemen. No delays. No platform dependence.

SPF/DKIM/DMARC is configured for email delivery, and end-to-end testing ensures everything works. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Upload files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. 6. Test the webhook flow: payment confirmation → order update → file delivery. 7. Deploy your storefront. 8. Load your products. 9. Test end-to-end with a real transaction. 10. Launch and sell globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys everything for you in 48 hours. No coding required. You get a fully operational store with five products loaded and tested.
What cryptocurrencies are supported?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—all under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. This is a one-time deployment. You own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform fees. Only NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually through your crypto wallet. The system does not automate refunds, but you retain full control over your funds.
Can I scale this system?
Yes. The architecture is modular and stateless. You can add more products, upgrade storage, or switch components as your business grows.
